data.component: Industrial CIP Motion Over EtherNet/IP Drive Profile & Axis Interpolator Engine

tests.details: Successfully parsed CipMotionSync and AxisInterpolatorSync with 11 variables. Bound registers: %M268, %M269, %R1150, %R1151, %R1152, %R1153, %R1154, %R1155, %R1156, %R1157.
Ladder logic contacts and coils strictly intercepted with ERR_LADDER_FORBIDDEN.
State machine transitions (Disabled -> Standstill -> Accelerating -> Disabled) verified deterministically.
Linear (585 steps) and S-curve (687 steps) trajectories smoothly converged to 100.0 mm respecting velocity, acceleration, and jerk limits.
CIP Sync cyclic jitter validated across 5 frames (< 100 ns, max 50.0 ns).
Velocity overrun (> 250 mm/s) trapped deterministically with 0xB301, clearing %M268.
Following error (1.20 mm > 0.50 mm) tripped 0xB302, asserting %M269 and clearing %M268.
Inverter overcurrent (32 A) and cyclic sync loss (65 ms) deterministically tripped 0xB303 and 0xB304.
Horner OCS registers (%R1150..%R1157, %M268..%M269) verified across healthy, tripped (0xB302), and operator reset recovery states.
